blind.B1: No exercise arm. Design is hind limb unloading (UN, 10 d) and unloading + 3 d reloading with cage ambulation (RL) versus cage control (CON) in soleus of adult (6 mo) and old (22-24 mo) male C57BL/6J mice (S1.1/S1.2, S2.1, S2.4.p1; FIG4). Disuse/reloading model, not exercise training; an exercise question does not apply directly.
blind.B2: Six groups age x {CON, UN, RL}; FIG4A/B compare UN and RL with CON within each age (S2.4.p1, FIG4 legend). RNA-seq n per group is not stated in the paper; GEO gives YC 9, YU 4, YR 4, OC 9, OU 6, OR 4 (36). Other assays use n=11 per group (FIG1) or n=4-9 (FIG4C).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one soleus per independent mouse; GEO titles 'Mouse Number k in <group>' are separate animals per group and age. The flagged key (age-stripped label) only matches young k to old k, which are different animals, so it is not an animal ID.
blind.B4: The paper does not say how RNA-seq comparisons were fitted (details are in the unavailable Supplementary Material, S1.8.p1; GEO data_processing names DESeq).
blind.B5: FIG4 legend (B): 'The RNA-sequencing data set used was filtered with reads per kilobase per million mapped reads (RPKM) >1, p <0.05.' Raw p, no fold-change cutoff. No DEG counts are reported.

checks.evidence: No exercise-training arm (S2.1.p1, S2.4.p1). Case ran as disuse/reloading with an explicit caveat in study.caveats and HANDBACK; it did not claim an exercise result.
GEO sample group gives YC 9, YU 4, YR 4, OC 9, OU 6, OR 4, all 36 aligned, no exclusions; control is the age-matched CON for each contrast (FIG4A).
Contrasts UN vs CON and RL vs CON (treatment vs control) per age; RL vs UN exploratory with UN as control. Ppargc1a, Esrra, Esrrg are negative in UN vs CON, matching S2.4.p1.

One soleus per independent mouse; the mechanical key links young k to old k across age, which are different animals even though the expression check says 'supported' (same-group mice correlate). No blocking needed.
Paper silent (S1.8 in supplement). One joint cell-means model on 36 samples with simple-effect contrasts is a declared choice.
All males, one tissue, no batch/lane in GEO; suitability sex pass. Age is a design factor.

Partek (Reads) columns are estimated counts (79% integer fraction, rounded) summed to gene; applied rule gives 52% of genes at p<0.05 and ~46% at padj<0.05 (deg_sanity 'implausible_sig_fraction'). Library sums reported as 1.7-1.9 M in one place and ~35 M in HANDBACK. A p-value histogram or a note on this was not seen.
checks.fix: Record the implausible-fraction flag in study.caveats and check the p-value histogram / library sizes of the Partek estimated counts.

checks.evidence: Paper rule transcribed as raw p < 0.05, no FC cutoff, non-inclusive (FIG4 legend B); BH padj < 0.05 reported as audit; CPM filter documented as deviation from RPKM > 1.
Paper gives no DEG counts; comparison limited to KEGG pathway direction and three genes, and HANDBACK states this.

human_items: Open policy: whether a hind-limb unloading/reloading series counts as an exercise-related study; it was run with a disuse/reloading label and caveat.
About half of all genes are DE under the paper's raw-p rule and ~46% under FDR; person may want to check the Partek estimated-count matrix behaviour.
summary: 该系列没有运动训练组，而是后肢去负荷（UN）与再负荷（RL）对照，案例已按“废用/再负荷”标注并写入 caveat，未当作运动结果。分组、方向、阈值（原始 p<0.05，无倍数变化）与论文一致；无重复测量，机械配对键只是跨年龄编号，不是同一只小鼠。唯一疑点是约一半基因显著（Partek 估计计数），建议记录并检查 p 值直方图，整体通过。
